name: 421-a(16) Affordable New York Housing Program Completion Extension - Letters of Intent
description:
This dataset contains 740 Letters of Intent filed under New York City's 421-a(16) Affordable New York Housing Program for completion extensions. Each record identifies a property by reported address, borough, tax block and lot, building identification number, and permit sequence, and includes reported total units, affordable units, construction commencement date, anticipated completion date, and affordability option (most commonly Option B). The data also includes presumed geographic attributes such as community board, council district, census tract, neighborhood tabulation area, postcode, and latitude/longitude, plus duplicate flags and weights for records that appear to cover the same building.

The dataset can be used to track development timelines and extension requests, map the location of affordable housing projects across the five boroughs, analyze the distribution of total and affordable units by neighborhood and affordability option, cross-reference filings against building permits, and assess how much of the pipeline is concentrated in areas such as Brooklyn and the Bronx.
